from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792546011/attempts/063d3d0630cb465fa0dfa1151ed4d5f6/system/state/workspace')
program=root/'programs'/'task-7b3a3cfe.py'
program.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    divider_color = 2
    divider_cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == divider_color]
    if not divider_cells:
        return out
    rows = {r for r, c in divider_cells}
    cols = {c for r, c in divider_cells}
    if len(cols) == 1 and len(rows) == h:
        dc = next(iter(cols))
        obj = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (grid[0][0], divider_color)]
        if obj:
            oc = [c for r, c in obj]
            target = min(oc) - 1 if max(oc) < dc else max(oc) + 1
            if 0 <= target < w:
                for r in range(h):
                    out[r][target] = 8
    elif len(rows) == 1 and len(cols) == w:
        dr = next(iter(rows))
        bg = grid[0][0]
        obj = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg, divider_color)]
        if obj:
            orows = [r for r, c in obj]
            target = min(orows) - 1 if max(orows) < dr else max(orows) + 1
            if 0 <= target < h:
                for c in range(w):
                    out[target][c] = 8
    return out
'''
